services.heading: Services
services.sub: Numbered by discipline. Engineered around the question you need answered.

ctaBand.heading: Not sure which one you need? Tell us the problem and we'll point you to the right one.

items.title: Web development
items.challenge: Is your website working as hard as you are?
items.body: Fast, accessible sites and web apps that turn visitors into customers, built around what each page has to achieve, not around a template.
solves: Web apps your team can actually maintain

items.title: UI/UX design
items.challenge: Can a stranger understand what you do in five seconds?
items.body: Interfaces designed around real user behavior: clear hierarchy, honest micro-interactions, and screens that make the next step obvious.

items.title: ERP systems
items.challenge: How many spreadsheets run your business?
items.body: Custom internal platforms that replace the patchwork: one source of truth for your people, your data and your workflows.

items.title: AI integrations
items.challenge: Which parts of your week should never need a human?
items.body: AI assistants and workflow automation with clear guardrails, so repetitive work runs itself and your people spend time on judgment.
solves: AI hype with no plan behind it

items.title: SEO optimization
items.challenge: When customers search for you, who do they find instead?
items.body: Technical SEO and answer-first content that earns organic visibility, built into the site rather than bolted on.

items.title: Booking platforms
items.challenge: How many bookings are lost between 'interested' and 'paid'?
items.body: Reservation, scheduling and checkout flows that remove friction and keep your calendar and payments in sync.
solves: Endless back-and-forth to confirm a slot

items.title: Dashboard systems
items.challenge: Can you answer 'how are we doing?' without asking three people?
items.body: Dashboards that turn raw data into decisions: live metrics, admin control centers and reporting leaders actually read.

items.title: Branding & identity
items.challenge: If your logo disappeared tomorrow, would anyone recognize you?
items.body: A brand system of voice, type, palette and rules that makes everything you ship look and sound like one company.

items.title: Maintenance & support
items.challenge: Who picks up the phone when it breaks at 9 p.m.?
items.body: Monitoring, updates and ongoing improvements, so what we launch keeps getting better instead of slowly rotting.

items.title: Digital marketing
items.challenge: Are you paying for traffic, or for customers?
items.body: Paid media, social and email programs tied to measurable outcomes, so growth is something you plan, not something you hope for.
solves: Ad spend with no clear return
Leads that never get followed up

process.heading: Process
process.sub: How we take a project from problem to production.

items.title: Understand the problem
items.body: We ask the uncomfortable questions first: what hurts, who feels it, what would 'fixed' look like?

items.title: Build it properly
items.body: Small working releases you can see and use, not a big reveal after months of silence.

items.title: Teach your team
items.body: We hand over the keys and train your people to run it, because software nobody understands isn't an asset.

contact.heading: Got a problem worth solving?
contact.sub: Tell us what's not working. You'll get a straight answer, not a sales script.
contact.crossLinkText: Training your team instead? See Workshops ↗

dialog.title: Book a call
dialog.sub: Direct technical discussion. Tell us what is broken or costing you time.
